verdict.rationale: HubSpot exposes extensive CRUD APIs for core objects (contacts, custom objects, deals) and CLI/API access covering much of the platform, plus an MCP server for agent access, but several UI-only capabilities (AI content generation tools, prospecting agent, plain-language report builder, sequences authoring, workflow builder) are documented only as UI features with no corresponding API/CLI endpoints evidenced, and no OpenAPI spec or llms.txt was found by probes. missing for 10: documented API parity for AI/reporting/workflow/sequence UI features, a public OpenAPI/machine-readable spec, and independent confirmation that all UI actions are API-reachable.
